paragraphs: Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems, and you want AI to be safe and beneficial for users and for society as a whole. As a member of the Applied AI team you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer who embeds directly with strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring those products meet customer requirements, and you will deliver technical artifacts such as MCP servers, sub‑agents, and agent skills for production workflows.

I have built agentic solutions using Python and PostgreSQL while maintaining continuous integration and collaborating closely with stakeholders. In another effort I created MCP services that combined search, GraphQL and open‑weight models on a PostgreSQL back‑end, also employing continuous integration. Both efforts involved LLMs, advanced prompt engineering and agent development, producing production‑ready artifacts that satisfy deployment at scale. I documented repeatable deployment patterns and fed insights back to product teams, demonstrating high agency and the ability to navigate ambiguity.

I have delivered end‑to‑end pipelines using Python, Docker and AWS Lambda with appropriate IAM roles, integrating fourteen source datasets into a unified service. I also built FastAPI applications that incorporated scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras models, containerising them with Docker for consistent production deployment. Both initiatives required strong Python programming, deployment at scale and clear communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. These experiences align with the requirement for Python expertise and show my capability to produce production‑grade AI solutions.
